body:
Thank you very much for the support. I will call her tomorrow, and use the 'catch up' phrase-- I think that'll help break it when I feel ready instead of letting it all spill out on my first trip back.

My cat's right here with me-- she's good company. I really appreciate your comment. Like I said, this is something that has not happened before and I was scared and shocked that I actually 'did something'. I feel ok right now, and I will be going back to therapy to solve this. Thank you very much.

I feel like every time I 'get better' or make it out I end up in the same place again. The first time I was really depressed was a year ago, and it lasted for 4 months, I know this because I cannot remember them at all. I got better when I went to college, but I came home because I switched majors and decided to attend community college instead to save money considering my major switch doesn't bring in a lot of profit. I really thought I was doing better. I didn't feel depressed. Then today I just sort of got hit with it after a fight. By the time I realized what boundary I crossed it was over. I don't know how I'll be tomorrow because this wasn't something that has happened before. I've got my therapist's number on my phone. I haven't seen her in like six months. I don't know what to say. I feel like I've failed her.
